topic: T5b: one-line adapter fix — ISO timestamps from the used-by read
lesson: Everything else is committed and green. The only failing test is 'lists one latest use per job by human decision record id…' in the Postgres suite: the adapter's listDecisionsByHumanDecisionRecordId returns lastUsedAt as the raw Postgres text ('2026-09-04 00:00:00+00') while the port promises an ISO string ('2026-09-04T00:00:00.000Z'). Fix it in adapters/storage/postgres/repositories/domain-repositories.postgres.ts by normalising the value the way the sibling reads in that file do (e.g. new Date(value).toISOString() or the existing timestamp helper); do not change the test's expectation. You cannot reach Postgres from your sandbox — the orchestrator runs that suite; just make the change, run tsc, and finish.
